text: Whole-screen capture exposed a real scale synchronization defect: t3 selected a sigma-2 result, but CompareSummary initialized to the first available scale (sigma 0.5). Failing focused regression reproduced None instead of ScaleIndex(2). Fix follows the named result scale, preserves explicit selector choices across unrelated sync, and follows a newly navigated result. JVM CompareSummarySuite 18 and PairedDescriptiveSuite 7 pass; recapture correctly shows +0.18 at sigma 2, consistent with fixture.json.
